process PRESTO_ASSEMBLEPAIRS {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/3b/3b9062f695043fa77de5e7e5e43c1b55693cae6d9610d9c3e28bef58aef08dad/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/presto:0.7.9--8b5f4848272f2d56'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(reads_1), path(reads_2)
    tuple val(meta2), path(reference)
    val mode

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_assemble-pass.{fastq,fastq.gz,fq,fq.gz}"), emit: reads, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}-{1,2}_assemble-fail.{fastq,fastq.gz,fq,fq.gz}"), emit: reads_fail, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_assemble.log"), emit: log
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_command_log.txt"), emit: command_log
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('presto'), eval('AssemblePairs.py --version | grep -o "[0-9][0-9.]*" | head -n 1'), emit: versions_presto, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def ref = reference ? "-r \"${reference}\"" : ''
    """
    AssemblePairs.py ${mode} \\
        -1 "${reads_1}" \\
        -2 "${reads_2}" \\
        ${ref} \\
        --outname "${prefix}" \\
        --log "${prefix}_assemble.log" \\
        --failed \\
        --nproc ${task.cpus} \\
        ${args} \\
        > ${prefix}_command_log.txt
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo "${args}"
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}_assemble-pass.fastq.gz
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}-1_assemble-fail.fastq.gz
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}-2_assemble-fail.fastq.gz
    touch ${prefix}_assemble.log \\
          ${prefix}_command_log.txt
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/presto/assemblepairs"
description: "Assembles paired-end reads into single reads using pRESTO AssemblePairs.py.\n\
  The `mode` input selects the subcommand: `align`, `join`, `reference` or `sequential`.\n\
  The subcommands share the same inputs, outputs and options, so they are exposed\n\
  through one module rather than four; only `reference` and `sequential` use the\n\
  reference input.\nThe `reference` and `sequential` modes default to `--aligner usearch`,\
  \ which is not\nin the container; pass `--aligner blastn` through `ext.args`.\n\
  The module sets `--nproc ${task.cpus}`; with more than one process the order of\n\
  the output records is not deterministic.\nOutput FASTQ file names follow the input\
  \ extension (e.g. `.fastq` or `.fq.gz`).\n"
keywords:
- "immcantation"
- "airrseq"
- "paired-end"
- "assembly"
- "immunoinformatics"
- "fastq"
tools:
- presto:
    description: "A bioinformatics toolkit for processing high-throughput lymphocyte\
      \ receptor sequencing data."
    homepage: "https://immcantation.readthedocs.io"
    documentation: "https://presto.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tools/AssemblePairs.html"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/immcantation/presto"
    doi: "10.1093/bioinformatics/btu138"
    licence:
    - "AGPL v3"
    identifier: "biotools:presto"
    args_id: "$args"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - reads_1:
      type: "file"
      description: "FASTQ file of the first read of each pair (R1)"
      pattern: "*.{fastq,fastq.gz,fq,fq.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1930"
  - reads_2:
      type: "file"
      description: "FASTQ file of the second read of each pair (R2)"
      pattern: "*.{fastq,fastq.gz,fq,fq.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1930"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. `[ id:'reference'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - reference:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional. Reference sequences in FASTA format.\nRequired by the\
        \ `reference` and `sequential` modes, ignored otherwise.\n"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fasta.gz,fa.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
- mode:
    type: "string"
    description: "AssemblePairs subcommand. One of `align`, `join`, `reference` or\
      \ `sequential`."
output:
  reads:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_assemble-pass.{fastq,fastq.gz,fq,fq.gz}:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Successfully assembled reads.\nOnly emitted when at\
          \ least one pair assembles.\n"
        pattern: "*_assemble-pass.{fastq,fastq.gz,fq,fq.gz}"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1930"
  reads_fail:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}-{1,2}_assemble-fail.{fastq,fastq.gz,fq,fq.gz}:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Reads of pairs that failed assembly, one file per\
          \ read (R1 and R2).\nOnly emitted when at least one pair fails.\n"
        pattern: "*-{1,2}_assemble-fail.{fastq,fastq.gz,fq,fq.gz}"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1930"
  log:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_assemble.log:
        type: "file"
        description: "Per-pair assembly log written by AssemblePairs.py"
        pattern: "*_assemble.log"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3671"
  command_log:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_command_log.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Standard output of AssemblePairs.py"
        pattern: "*_command_log.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3671"
  versions_presto:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - presto:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - AssemblePairs.py --version | grep -o "[0-9][0-9.]*" | head -n 1:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - presto:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - AssemblePairs.py --version | grep -o "[0-9][0-9.]*" | head -n 1:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
